predecessors.name: Beixin culture
predecessors.text: "central and southern Shandong and northern Jiangsu provinces" (Beixin type site at Tengzhou)

successors.name: Longshan culture
successors.text: Shandong, "primarily located in the eastern province of Shandong", with the Beixin country of northern Jiangsu, and sites "in Anhui, Henan and Jiangsu"

ledger.x: 4100 BCE: the Dawenkou culture rises on the Beixin lands of Shandong and northern Jiangsu: "descends from the Beixin"; "the early phase (4100-3500 BC)".
4100 BCE: the rest of Shandong, the eastern province where the culture was "primarily located", is the Dawenkou country from its early phase.
3500 BCE: the middle Dawenkou begins: "the middle phase (3500-3000 BC)".
3000 BCE: the late Dawenkou begins: "the late phase (3000-2600 BC)".

2600 BCE: the Dawenkou gives way to the Longshan culture ("The culture existed from 4300 to 2600 BC"; "Followed by: Longshan culture"; "Shandong Longshan... inherited much of its ancestry from Dawenkou").

certainty.note: No border is recorded; the culture is known from sites and burials.
